Execute every input with greater confidence through advanced controls made for competitive play. Razer™ Snap Flex lets you trigger precise actions on key release for tighter control and faster response, while Razer™ Snap Tap prioritizes the latest input between two selected keys for near-instant directional changes. With Dynamic Keystroke, assign up to 4 actions to a single keystroke and cancel instantly to adapt on the fly. Stay ahead of every play with true 8000 Hz HyperPolling, delivering a polling rate 8 times faster than the industry standard for near-zero latency response. Its compact 65% form factor gives you more room to maneuver your mouse while remaining easy to position and tournament-ready. Finished with textured doubleshot PBT keycaps, a durable 5052 aluminum alloy top case, and hybrid onboard storage for up to 6 profiles, this keyboard is built to perform wherever competition takes you.
